name: Hamstring Walkout
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, your feet flat on the floor hip width apart and your arms by your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips into a glute bridge.
Keep your hips high and take small steps with your heels away from your body until your legs are almost straight.
Do not let your hips sag or rotate as you step.
Walk your heels back toward your hips to the bridge position. That is one repetition.
Lower your hips to the floor when the set is done.
